assertion_results.text: Bug parsing correctly extracts all four required sections (Description, Steps to Reproduce, Expected Result, Actual Result) using the heading formats from bug-template-mock.md (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md lists template heading formats ('### **Issue Description**', '### **Steps to Reproduce**', '### **Expected Result**', '### **Actual Result**') and marks each FOUND with extracted content, e.g. 'Description (`### **Issue Description**`) — FOUND' with the trailing-whitespace description, Steps 1-3, Expected 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §Migration Patterns...', Actual 'do NOT reference the Migration Patterns convention'. Validation outcome: 'The four core required sections ... were all extracted using the template heading formats.'

assertion_results.text: Bug validation confirms the issue type ID (10020) matches the Bug issue type ID from Bug Configuration (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md 'Issue type validation': 'Issue `issuetype.id`: **10020** (Bug)', 'Bug Configuration `Bug issue type ID`: **10020**', 'Result: **MATCH**. ACME-500 is a Bug.'

assertion_results.text: Investigation identifies the trailing-whitespace heading extraction as the root cause — line[3:] does not strip whitespace (Steps 2-3)
assertion_results.evidence: investigation.md: 'Input line `## Migration Patterns  ` gives key "Migration Patterns  "' and 'Divergence point: the behavior goes wrong at the extraction step (`line[3:]` with no strip)'; affected-files table marks `section_name = line[3:]` as 'Defect site. Trailing whitespace is not stripped from heading text'.

assertion_results.text: Root cause comment includes: what is broken (heading extraction does not strip trailing whitespace), where it is broken (plan-feature convention lookup), and how to verify the fix (reproducer test with whitespace in heading) (Step 4)
assertion_results.evidence: root-cause.md: '**What is broken:** heading extraction keeps trailing whitespace, so convention-name matching fails.'; '**Where:** the plan-feature convention lookup in `plugins/sdlc-workflow/skills/plan-feature/SKILL.md`.'; 'Reproducer Strategy' section: fixture with `## Migration Patterns  ` (two trailing spaces), assert Implementation Notes contain the convention note, 'fails before the fix ... and passes after it.'

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST acceptance criterion — before any fix criteria (Step 5 Acceptance Criteria ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md Acceptance Criteria first item: '- [ ] Reproducer: a plan-feature eval with `CONVENTIONS.md` heading `## Migration Patterns  ` (trailing whitespace) fails before the fix ... and passes after the fix'; fix criteria (whitespace stripping, warning) follow.

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST test requirement — with explicit assertion guidance derived from the Steps to Reproduce (Step 5 Test Requirements ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md Test Requirements first item: 'Reproducer eval: fixture `CONVENTIONS.md` contains `## Migration Patterns  ` followed by `Add Index::create() for all FK columns.`; run plan-feature on a feature that needs an FK migration; assert the generated task's Implementation Notes contain `Per CONVENTIONS.md §Migration Patterns: add Index::create() for all FK columns.` exactly ... Before the fix, this assertion fails'.
